title: Runs on a 100% deterministic core
caption: One mechanism, three triggers, one deterministic core.
prose: Three things can start it and it does three different things with the answer. What happens in between is the same every time.

three-triggers.description: Pre-read agent hook, pre-commit gate, or manual check all execute the identical deterministic core.

predictable-eval.description: Configuration and file inputs produce the exact same verdict every run.

three-triggers.title: One deterministic core
three-triggers.keywords: three triggers, runtime pre-read, commit gate, nightly schedule
three-triggers.script: Three ways in. Three ways out. And the middle is the same every time. Whatever starts it, the core does one thing: read the configuration, run the logic. Same input, same answer. It's fully deterministic. The one I want to show you is the first: the agent goes to read a file — and before it does, it's told that file is stale. The other two, briefly: on commit, a check that the frontmatter meets the standard, passing or blocking. And on a schedule: a nightly run that regenerates what can be regenerated, and raises a ticket on what can't.
three-triggers.bridge: Let me show you the first one.
